Developer junk, found and scored

Developer junk detection that knows what's safe to nuke. 9 categories of cruft with crap scores, a path and date on every find, and smart exclusions that won't touch your tools.

#### Seek & Destroy

node_modules, __pycache__, .git bloat, build artifacts, caches - found and flagged.

#### Crap Scores

Every item scored by safety. 100% = nuke it. 50% = check first. You decide.

#### Where & When

Shows every find's path and when it was last touched. Won't break your workflow.

#### Regenerable Badges

"npm install will bring this back." Delete with confidence.

#### 9 Categories

Build artifacts, caches, package managers, logs, Python environments, version control - all sorted and scored.

#### Smart Protection

3-layer exclusion system. Your system files, dev tools and package managers are automatically safe. Zero false positives in our test across six project types and three package managers, and everything goes to quarantine first anyway.
